content: हिंस्र {%a.%} [हिंस्-र्] Injurious, noxious, mischievous, hurtful, murderous; व्याधिता वाधिवेत्तव्या हिंस्रार्थघ्री च सर्वदा <ls>Ms. 9. 80</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">12. 56</ls>. .²2 Terrible. .²3 Cruel, fierce, savage. .{@-स्रः@} .²1 A fierce animal, beast of prey; सा दुष्प्रधर्षा मनसापि हिंस्रैः <ls>R. 2. 27</ls>. .²2 A destroyer. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Bhīma. .²5 A man who delights in injuring living creatures; <ls>Ms. 3. 164</ls>. .{@-स्रम्@} Cruelty; <ls>Ms. 1. 29</ls>.
